title: Larabanga Mosque
geometryBasis: The native historic mosque envelope and named point establish the site beside the baobab. The Ghana Museums and Monuments Board supplies the approximate 8m square body. Buttresses project from that body within the wider mapped envelope.
sectionBasis: The two cleared photos show the restored mud-plaster form, unequal towers, tapered buttresses, dark base, torons and patterned entrance panel. The photographed proportions guide the roof and tower heights.
limitations: The 2010 publication date anchors the whitewashed appearance. The approximate 8m body scale follows the Ghana Museums and Monuments Board. The tower heights, corner profiles, rear door positions and timber sizes are estimates.
The relief of the earthen plaster and the entry grille are simplified for medium-fi viewing. The original terrain field is preserved and threshold registration is approximate.
